notes: Money-transfer / exchange office, Casablanca; yellow fascia and logo cube with a 'Change' panel below (the mirrored 'Change' seen through the cube is a reflection, not a line). An Arabic word on the fascia is cut off at the right edge; partial Arabic shop signs at left and a red banner at bottom right are distractors; '50' painted on the wall. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: DavidDennisPhotos.com
attribution: Photo: DavidDennisPhotos.com, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/50852241@N00/299649965. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Small blue medina name plate with raised letters on an ochre wall (Marrakech): 'the New Qissariya' (a covered market area). Spelled القسارية as on the plate (no ي after ق; not the standard spelling القيسارية). Arabic only, no French line. Paint worn and rust-streaked; source image is 1024 px.

author: Benson Kua
attribution: Photo: Benson Kua, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/91545223@N00/16393179645. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted gym boards on a whitewashed wall (Tangier medina). Target is the name across the top of the right-hand board. The painted bodybuilders are illustrations, not real people; the supplement-tub labels (PROTEN, MASS+ 2000, weider 2000, MAS, PLUS, COMPLE...) are distractors.

author: austinevan
attribution: Photo: austinevan, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/19762676@N00/3182419814. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Restaurant facade in Marrakech: white 'McDonald's' letters with golden-arches M at upper left, golden arches in the centre, large Arabic 'ماكدونالدز' at upper right. A smaller Arabic repeat sits under the terrace railing. Distractor: blue Happy Meal promotional banner (French). People at the terrace and passers-by in the foreground are incidental.

author: www.davidrosenphotography.com
attribution: Photo: www.davidrosenphotography.com, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/91492606@N07/15756656356. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Roadside distance sign, two white panels. The Arabic panel is heavily sprayed with black and red graffiti: 'مراكش' is legible but the distance after it is partly overpainted ('11' visible, third digit hidden), so only the name is transcribed. Red graffiti 'S.K' under the Latin line is a distractor.

author: andynash
attribution: Photo: andynash, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/94611718@N00/15921974775. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Rusty hanging board with painted smiling lips, in a narrow medina lane (Essaouira). Not transcribed: the small bottom line with a phone number (GSM 06 10 74 ...) and the proprietor's name in Arabic, which are too small and rusty to read reliably. The sign gives a trade, not a proper name.
source_title: Essaouira street scenes and markets - Sept 2014 - 05

Distractors: red 'CAFE RESTAURANT TICHKA' board at left, 'N° 9' on the building behind.
